name: Unisys Herschel
source:
Affiliation: Magic Institute
Hobby: Sewing
Special Skill: Understanding the Feelings of Animals
Likes: Spicy Food
Dislikes: Sweets

An orphan that Johan adopted.
A member of the Anhel tribe that chooses their gender around puberty, but they haven't chosen yet.
Because of that they aren't really close to anybody but Johan.
They adore Johan very much and believe anything he says.
